title: Higher-Categorical Models of Continuous and Spacetime Symmetries
exact_target: Build precise higher-categorical descriptions recovering continuous internal and spacetime symmetries of field theories.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006633 (OWR-14299913-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Higher Structures from Symmetries in Quantum Field Theory (2026), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2026/12, pp. 737--794. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: This is a construction programme. Which higher category, topology on continuous data and functorial properties are used must be specified in a proposed framework.
